Why Study in Australia?

Country-specific advantages for academic and career progression

World Top 100 Universities

Home to the prestigious Group of Eight (Go8) institutions recognized globally for research and teaching.

Post-Study Work Rights

Qualify for 2 to 4 years on the Temporary Graduate Visa (Subclass 485) to gain professional experience.

Generous Merit Scholarships

Universities offer international student fee reductions of 15% to 30% per year for academic merit.

Regional Study Advantages

Studying in designated regional cities (Adelaide, Perth, Gold Coast) grants extra post-study work years.

Education Pathway for Bangladeshi Students

Step-by-step qualification progression for SSC, HSC, Diploma, and Bachelor graduates

Pathway 1

SSC / O-Level

Foundation Studies (8-12 Months) → Bachelor Degree

Bridge into top Australian universities through comprehensive university-affiliated foundation colleges.

Pathway 2

HSC / A-Level

Diploma Pathway (Year 1) or Direct Bachelor (3 Years)

Enter directly with HSC GPA 4.0+ or via 1-year Higher Education Diplomas leading into Year 2.

Pathway 3

Diploma (4-Year BTEB)

Bachelor Degree with up to 1-Year Credit Exemption

Polytechnic diploma holders receive advanced standing credits into Australian engineering and IT degrees.

Pathway 4

Bachelor Degree (4 Years)

2-Year Master's Degree (Coursework / Research)

Direct admission for Bachelor graduates with CGPA 2.8+ from recognized Bangladeshi universities.

* Final eligibility depends on university, course, academic profile, English score, study gap and other admission requirements.

Australia Student Visa Process

Official step-by-step roadmap from university offer to visa stamp

1

Course Application & Offer Letter

Submit academic transcripts, SOP, and passport to obtain an Offer Letter.

2

Genuine Student (GS) Assessment

Complete university financial assessment and GS documentation.

3

Pay Initial Tuition Deposit & OSHC

Pay 1st semester tuition + Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC).

4

Receive Confirmation of Enrolment (COE)

Obtain official electronic COE from the university.

5

Submit Online Visa Application (ImmiAccount)

Lodge Subclass 500 visa application with biometric appointment at VFS.

Frequently Asked Questions

Country-specific answers verified by ALO Education compliance

What is Genuine Student (GS) requirement in Australia?

The GS requirement assesses whether an applicant genuinely intends to study in Australia, taking into account academic history, financial capacity, and career value.

What is a Confirmation of Enrolment (COE)?

A COE is an official document issued by an Australian education provider verifying you have accepted an offer and paid your tuition deposit.

How much bank balance is required for Australian Student Visa from Bangladesh?

You must demonstrate 1 year of tuition fee + $29,710 AUD living costs + return airfare held in an approved bank with clear source of funds.

What is Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC)?

OSHC is mandatory medical insurance covering hospital and medical expenses during your entire stay in Australia.

What is the part-time work hour limit in Australia?

48 hours per fortnight during semester terms, and unlimited hours during official semester vacations.

How long is the Post-Study Work Visa (Subclass 485)?

Bachelor graduates get 2 years, Master's coursework graduates get 2 years, and Master's research/PhD graduates get 3 years, with additional regional bonus years.

What are the main intake months for Australian universities?

February/March (Semester 1) and July/August (Semester 2), with select November mini-intakes.

Are polytechnic diploma graduates eligible for Australian universities?

Yes, BTEB diploma graduates can enter Bachelor's degree programs with up to 1 year of credit exemption.

Can I bring my spouse to Australia on a Student Visa?

Yes, married students can include their spouse as a secondary applicant on the Subclass 500 visa.

What is the Group of Eight (Go8)?

The Group of Eight consists of Australia's top eight research-intensive universities (e.g., University of Melbourne, USYD, UNSW, ANU).

What English tests are accepted for Australian visa?

IELTS Academic, PTE Academic, TOEFL iBT, and Cambridge C1 Advanced.

What is the minimum IELTS required for Australian Master's?

Typically 6.5 overall with no individual band below 6.0.

How long does Australian visa processing take in Bangladesh?

Processing generally takes 4 to 8 weeks depending on the university sector and risk tier.

What is the minimum wage for international students in Australia?

The Australian national minimum wage is $24.10 AUD per hour (plus 25% casual loading for casual work).

Can parents sponsor my education in Australia?

Yes, parents, siblings, or blood relatives can act as financial sponsors with documented income tax returns and bank statements.

What are regional study benefits in Australia?

Studying in regional areas like Perth, Adelaide, or Newcastle provides an extra 1-2 years on your Post-Study Work Visa.

Do Australian universities offer scholarships to Bangladeshi students?

Yes, most universities offer merit-based scholarships ranging from 15% to 30% tuition fee reduction each year.

Where do I submit biometrics for Australia in Dhaka?

At the VFS Australia Visa Application Centre located in Delta Life Tower, Gulshan-2, Dhaka.

Can I change my course or university after arriving in Australia?

Under visa condition 8202, you must remain in the same or higher AQF level course and complete at least 6 months of your primary course before transferring.

How does ALO Education help with Australian admissions?

ALO Education provides university shortlisting, GTE/GS statement drafting, scholarship applications, and complete visa file preparation.
